title: data for channel.health_changed
description: Meta health of a WhatsApp number changed: the sending status reported by Meta (health_status.can_send_message) changed, or the quality rating dropped (GREEN to YELLOW/RED, YELLOW to RED). The first reading only emits when the number is already limited or blocked. Read by the channel health check (every 30 minutes and after Meta quality webhooks).

can_send.description: available: meets all requirements; limited: sends with limitations (see reason); blocked: Meta rejects sends from this number. null = not read yet.

reason.description: First error description (blocked) or additional info (limited) sent by Meta, verbatim (usually English). null when available.

quality_rating.description: Meta quality rating: GREEN, YELLOW, RED, NA or UNKNOWN.

name_status.description: Display name review: APPROVED, AVAILABLE_WITHOUT_REVIEW, DECLINED, EXPIRED, PENDING_REVIEW or NONE.

messaging_limit.description: Meta messaging limit tier (whatsapp_business_manager_messaging_limit), e.g. TIER_250, TIER_2K, TIER_10K, TIER_100K, TIER_UNLIMITED.

state.description: Since v0.13.0. Explained health: available (no Meta restriction); limited (sends normally up to the messaging limit for business-initiated conversations); initiate_blocked (replies within 24 hours work, templates are refused, e.g. payment method issue); blocked (Meta blocks sending); unknown (health not read yet).

headline.description: Since v0.13.0. One pt-BR sentence explaining what the number can do now (same text as the panel).
